name: Carolai Anise
summary: In Brill, Carolai Anise teaches alchemy as her experiments unsettle the guards.

sections.title: A Volatile Craft
sections.body: Carolai Anise teaches novice alchemists in Brill and pursues her own strange brews. Many Forsaken researchers work under the Royal Apothecary Society's grim mandate. Carolai's unpredictable experiments and smoking retorts are well known, and the Deathguards watching Brill openly grumble that she seems bent on blowing up her own house.

faq.answer: In Brill, Carolai Anise teaches aspiring Forsaken to brew potions, elixirs, and oils. She is an undead alchemy trainer in Tirisfal Glades.
Carolai works with her alchemy supplies inside a building in Brill, the primary Forsaken town in central Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why do the Deathguards complain about her?
faq.answer: The Deathguards complain that Carolai's unstable experiments could cause an accident. They joke or fret that she may eventually blow up her entire house.

angles.text: As a newly liberated Forsaken learning to handle reagents, you can learn the foundations of alchemy from Carolai in Tirisfal Glades.
As a gatherer in Tirisfal, you can bring Carolai peacebloom, silverleaf, and earthroot to refine into potent mixtures.
